description: Source code for the LoanApplication class and related functions in the loan management module of ERPNext, handling loan validation, pledge setting, repayment calculations, and creation of loan and pledge documents.

classes.name: LoanApplication
classes.description: Represents a loan application document with validation, pledge setting, repayment calculation, and related functionalities.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the loan application, including pledge amount, loan amount, and sanctioned amount limits.

methods.name: validate_loan_type
methods.description: Checks if the selected loan type matches the company.

methods.name: validate_loan_amount
methods.description: Ensures the loan amount is within allowed limits.

methods.name: check_sanctioned_amount_limit
methods.description: Verifies if the total loan amount exceeds sanctioned limits.

methods.name: set_pledge_amount
methods.description: Calculates pledge amounts and post-haircut amounts for proposed securities.

methods.name: get_repayment_details
methods.description: Calculates repayment amount, periods, and total payable amount based on repayment method.

methods.name: calculate_payable_amount
methods.description: Computes total payable amount and interest over the loan tenure.

methods.name: set_loan_amount
methods.description: Sets the loan amount based on proposed pledges for secured loans.

methods.name: create_loan
methods.description: Creates a Loan document from a Loan Application, optionally submitting it.

methods.name: create_pledge
methods.description: Creates a Loan Security Pledge document from a Loan Application.

methods.name: get_proposed_pledge
methods.description: Calculates proposed pledges and maximum loan amount based on securities input.
